meta.note: Genesis snapshot for the Cousin Congress. Every replica derives identical genesis operations from this file, so it can be edited freely before first deployment — but after devices are in the field, treat it as append-only history and make changes through the app instead.

bills.title: The Pizza Friday Establishment Act
bills.summary: Establishes the last Friday of each month as Pizza Friday, provides for equitable topping allocation, and creates the Office of the Slice Auditor.
bills.text:
SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE.
This Act may be cited as the "Pizza Friday Establishment Act".

SEC. 2. DESIGNATION.
The last Friday of each calendar month is designated as Pizza Friday, to be observed by all member households.

SEC. 3. TOPPING EQUITY.
(a) No fewer than one-half of all pies shall carry toppings approved by unanimous consent of those present.
(b) Pineapple remains a matter of conscience and shall not be whipped.

SEC. 4. SLICE AUDITOR.
The Clerk shall appoint a Slice Auditor to certify fair distribution, who may not audit their own plate.

bills.title: The Annual Reunion Site Selection Act
bills.summary: Prescribes a rotating site selection process for the annual cousin reunion and establishes the tie-break authority of the Speaker's coin.
bills.text:
SECTION 1. ROTATION.
The reunion shall rotate among districts in order of seniority of their senior member.

SEC. 2. PETITION FOR VARIANCE.
A district may petition to swap its year with the consent of both districts and a majority of the Congress.

SEC. 3. TIE-BREAK.
All ties shall be resolved by the Speaker's commemorative coin, minted 2019, heads meaning yes.

bills.title: The Board Game Tournament Fairness Act
bills.summary: Bans undisclosed house rules in sanctioned tournaments and requires publication of all rule variants no later than 48 hours before first roll.
bills.text:
SECTION 1. DISCLOSURE.
All house rules must be entered into the record 48 hours before tournament play begins.

SEC. 2. BANKER NEUTRALITY.
The banker in any property-trading game shall not simultaneously hold the thimble.

SEC. 3. PENALTIES.
Violations are referred to the Committee on Games & Recreation, which may impose a one-round supervised snack fetch.

bills.title: The Group Chat Decorum Resolution
bills.summary: Sets quiet hours for the family group chat, regulates the use of the siren emoji, and protects the right to leave a message on read during exams.
bills.text:
SECTION 1. QUIET HOURS.
No non-emergency message shall be posted between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. in the recipient-majority time zone.

SEC. 2. SIREN EMOJI.
The siren emoji is reserved for actual emergencies and reunion date announcements.

SEC. 3. READ RECEIPTS.
During examination periods, a message may be left on read without prejudice.

amendments.author: m-sam
amendments.text: In Section 3(a), strike "one-half" and insert "one-third", and add at the end: "Provided, that at least one pie shall be plain cheese as a refuge for the undecided."

amendments.author: m-zadie
amendments.text: Add a new Section 4: "The coin flip shall be recorded on video and preserved in the archives of the Committee on Communications."

news.title: Pizza Friday Act reaches the floor after marathon markup
news.excerpt: H.CC. 101 cleared the Committee on Ways, Means & Snacks on a bipartisan basis after the adoption of the cheese refuge amendment. Final passage is expected this sitting.
news.body: After three weeks in markup, the Pizza Friday Establishment Act was reported favourably to the floor. Chairwoman Lena Okafor called it 'the most significant provisioning measure of the session.' The bill faces one recorded objection from the Clerk, who is holding out for calzones.
news.author: Office of the Clerk

news.title: Speaker announces the autumn sitting calendar
news.excerpt: The chamber will sit on the first and third Sunday of each month through December, with a full-attendance sitting scheduled for the Thanksgiving recess.
news.body: Speaker June Maxwell laid the autumn calendar before the chamber, noting that video attendance remains in order for members in distant districts. The Sergeant-at-Arms was directed to ensure the good couch is reserved for senior members.
news.author: Speaker's Office

news.title: Tournament Fairness Act signed; thimble neutrality now family law
news.excerpt: H.CC. 103 was signed at a ceremony in the main chamber. The banker may no longer hold the thimble, effective immediately.
news.body: In a ceremony attended by all districts, the Board Game Tournament Fairness Act became the third measure enacted by the First Cousin Congress. The signing pen has been deposited with the archives, which is a shoebox under Theo's bed.
news.author: Office of the Clerk

news.title: Motion to extend movie night fails under the two-thirds rule
news.excerpt: Despite a 5–4 majority, the privileged motion fell short of the two-thirds threshold required under Rule 6 for schedule extensions on a school night.
news.body: The Parliamentarian's ruling that Rule 6 applied was decisive. 'The math is the math,' said Zadie Reyes. Proponents have signalled they will reintroduce the motion for a Friday sitting, where a simple majority suffices.
news.author: Press Gallery

comments.author: Grandma Rosa (constituent)
comments.body: I have reviewed Section 3 and I approve, provided somebody saves me a plain slice. The cheese refuge clause shows real statesmanship.

comments.author: Uncle Dave (constituent)
comments.body: Respectfully, the last Friday of the month is bowling night. I urge the chamber to consider the second Friday and will be submitting a petition.

comments.author: Aunt Simone (constituent)
comments.body: No position on rotation order, but the coin from 2019 has come up heads eleven consecutive times and I want that noted in the record.
